"""Fast candidate wrapper: uses submission/main.py validation + a prebuilt engine."""
import importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sub_main', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
M = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(M)

BIN = os.path.join(os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/workspace/tmp'), 'unit-merge-build', 'engine')

def candidate_out(data):
    try:
        raw = data.encode('utf-8')
        need_len = len(raw) <= 8 * 1024 * 1024
        if not need_len:
            raise M.Invalid('size')
        text = raw.decode('utf-8')
        if text.startswith('\ufeff'):
            raise M.Invalid('bom')
        request = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=M.pairs, parse_constant=M.invalid_constant,
                             parse_float=M.finite)
        words = M.transport(request)
    except (M.Invalid, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        return '{"error":"invalid"}\n'
    p = subprocess.run([BIN], input=words, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
    return p.stdout.decode()
PYEOF
